name: modelable-vscode
description: Language support for Modelable .mdl data contracts.

chatParticipants.name: modelable
chatParticipants.description: Ask about and safely manage the current Modelable workspace.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply the exact pending change set.

modelable.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Path to a Python interpreter that has the `modelable` package installed. The extension launches it as `<pythonPath> -m modelable.lsp`. Leave empty to auto-detect (repo-local `cli/.venv` during Modelable development, otherwise `modelable` on PATH).

modelable.serverCommand.markdownDescription: Full command and arguments used to launch the Modelable language server, e.g. `["modelable", "lsp"]`. Overrides `modelable.pythonPath` and auto-detection when set.

enumDescriptions: Use the provider selected elsewhere (the workspace `ai:` block, or the `MODELABLE_LLM_PROVIDER` environment variable).
A local Ollama server (default base URL `http://localhost:11434`).
Anthropic's API; the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable must be set and `modelable.llm.model` must be provided.
modelable.llm.provider.markdownDescription: LLM provider used by the `@modelable` chat participant. Passed to the language server as `MODELABLE_LLM_PROVIDER`.

enumDescriptions: Do not set a specific model; inherit the workspace `ai:` block or the `MODELABLE_LLM_MODEL` environment variable.
modelable.llm.model.markdownDescription: Model used for `@modelable` turns. Passed to the language server as `MODELABLE_LLM_MODEL`. The list shows common models; to use any other model currently installed on your Ollama server (see `modelable models`), type its name directly in `settings.json`.

modelable.llm.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the LLM server (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:11434` for Ollama). Leave empty to use the provider default. Passed to the language server as `MODELABLE_LLM_BASE_URL`.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check conversationClient.js && node --check conversationParticipant.js && node --check conversationPreview.js
